selection_frame: All original 437 published packages; GPS/GNSS exact sensor tags then prior DOI/study-ID duplicate and metadata-only first-wave triage, no opened new animal GPS outcomes
study_identity_rule: Require exactly one public study ID and one DOI per sampled package. For duplicate repository study IDs choose lexically earliest (original publication date, package UUID), retain every rejected alias with explicit reason and never double count
prior_exclusion: All 12 DOI in previously frozen source-equal original GPS analysis plus 1 Illinois original DOI; never count an additional package that shares their original repository study ID
license_first_wave: Public registry license exactly CC0 1.0 Universal; other licenses preserved as review rather than assumed impermissible
scientific_name_rule: At least one unique nonempty scientific_name label; exactly one name = single native, 2+ names = multiple native; original schema still unverified
wave_selection_rule: SHA256(rank_salt + | + original catalog git blob + | + repository study ID + | + package UUID) within each single/multi metadata stratum; take first 8 each. Do not use title, species name, geography, observed q, previous effect signs or future file metadata to rank.
source_only_file_policy: After deterministic wave is source frozen, request original provider file-list metadata only (bitstream UUID, filename, byte count and MD5). Prefer one explicitly GPS/tracking named candidate if unique, else one unique primary CSV(.gz)/ZIP; if two CSVs choose >=10x larger only with >=10MB; otherwise ambiguous HOLD; original bytes <= 200MB.
source_permission: No raw telemetry, individual IDs, coordinates or exact timestamps may be redistributed. CC0 label is metadata, not final consent or geographic independence certificate.
inference_boundary: A finite fixed 2026-10-19 snapshot of public repository packages, not a random global biological study population. Later original-file metadata or event-supported eligibility may differ; always preserve denominators and HOLDs. No causal or confirmatory ecological inference at this stage.
